questions.question: A directory structure is used to __________. Choices: organize directory information on your computer; create maps that help students navigate between campus buildings; find manila files in a file cabinet; provide detailed information about file contents.
CLI is the acronym for __________. Choices: core language interpreter; content line interpreter; command-line interface; command-line interpreter.
Conventional users who log on to CentOS 7 are automatically placed in the __________ directory. Choices: systems; root; home; user.

In CentOS 7, the command to change a directory is __________. Choices: the same as the command in Windows 10, and case does not matter; the same as the command in Windows 10, but it must be lowercase; complicated and not widely used; cd.

The absolute path __________. Choices: is a path to a file that begins with the drive identifier and root directory and ends with the complete filename; begins with the backslash symbol (\) before the directory path in Windows; begins with the forward slash symbol (/) before the directory path in Linux; requires no symbol before the directory path.
The __________ command in CentOS 7 displays your directories and files. Choices: dir; cd; show; ls.
The DIR command is used to __________. Choices: display the contents of a single file; list the directories and subdirectories on a disk; list the files in a directory.

The MOVE command in Windows 10 and the mv command in CentOS 7 __________. Choices: copy the contents of one file to another location, leaving the original intact; can be used interchangeably; move a file to another location; automatically rename the file as it is processed.

The relative path __________. Choices: is implied to be the current working directory when a directory path is not listed in a command prompt; begins with the backslash symbol (\) before the directory path in Windows; begins with the forward slash symbol (/) before the directory path in Linux.

The TREE command is used to __________. Choices: display the contents of a single file; list the directories and subdirectories on a disk; organize the files on a disk; list the files in a directory using the /F switch.
To change the directory in Windows 10, you can use which of the following commands? Choices: cd; changeDIR; CD; CHDIR.
To create a directory in CentOS 7, use the __________ command. Choices: cddir; dir; makedir; mkdir; chdir.
To remove a directory in CentOS 7, __________. Choices: use the remove command; use the rm command; you use the same command that is used in Windows 10; use the rmdir command.
When you use a long name for a directory, you may __________. Choices: use lowercase letters; use uppercase letters; have spaces between words; more than 200 characters.

When you use the more command with the ls command in CentOS 7, __________. Choices: all information about files and directories disappear; you can scroll through the listing page by page; nothing happens; you need to use the less command; you are prompted for additional file information.
Which of the following can you use to display directory structures in Windows 10? Choices: File Explorer; Directory Manager; Command prompt; Windows directory viewer.
Which of the following commands can you use in Windows 10 to remove a directory and its files? Choices: RM; RDDIR; RD; RMDIR.

White space is __________. Choices: any blank area of a window.; used to provide files with longer, more meaningful names; not available in a window; used to help you locate files and folders more easily by using the options available.

Wildcard characters are used in commands to __________. Choices: match single characters to specify groups of files; match strings of characters to specify groups of files; match files with the same extension; speed the process of accessing files.
You can open a __________ to access the CLI in CentOS 7. Choices: Windows Console; terminal window; directory viewer; command prompt.
